step1_analysis.description: The extracted netlist consists of two independent NMOS transistors with grounded sources. By adding load resistors and complementary inputs, it functions as a pseudo-differential amplifier, which is a fundamental building block in high-speed broadband amplifiers like the one described in the paper.

paper_reference.title: 40-Gb/s Amplifier and ESD Protection Circuit in 0.18-m CMOS Technology

voltage_gain.description: Low-frequency differential voltage gain of the amplifier.

sky130_expected.calculation: Id = 0.5 * 270uA/V^2 * (5/0.5) * (0.9V - 0.42V)^2 = 311 uA. gm = 2 * Id / Vov = 2 * 311uA / 0.48V = 1.3 mA/V. Assuming a 1kOhm load resistor, Gain = gm * Rload = 1.3 V/V = 2.28 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The extracted netlist lacks the inductive peaking and cascaded stages of the full paper circuit, so the gain will be significantly lower than the reported 15 dB.

sky130_expected.calculation: Bandwidth is limited by the RC time constant at the output. C_parasitic ~ 10 fF. BW = 1 / (2 * pi * Rload * C_parasitic) = 1 / (2 * pi * 1k * 10fF) = 15.9 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Without the triple-resonance network and T-coils mentioned in the paper, the bandwidth is purely RC-limited by the load resistor and transistor parasitics.

power_consumption.description: Total DC power dissipated by the circuit.

sky130_expected.reasoning: This is a single stage with small transistors, whereas the paper reports power for a multi-stage cascaded amplifier operating at 2.2V.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure differential voltage gain, -3dB bandwidth, and power consumption of the pseudo-differential pair.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Pseudo-Differential Amplifier
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u

* DUT
XM2 LABEL_NET_0 Y GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM1 X VIN GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}

* Power Supply
VVDD VDD 0 1.8

* Inputs (Differential)
VVIN VIN 0 DC 0.9 AC 1 SIN(0.9 0.1 1MEG 0 0)
VY Y 0 DC 0.9 AC -1 SIN(0.9 0.1 1MEG 180 0)

* Load Resistors
R1 X VDD 1k
R2 LABEL_NET_0 VDD 1k

.control
* 1. DC Operating Point for Power Consumption
op
let total_current = -i(VVDD)
let power_dissipation = total_current * 1.8
print power_dissipation

* 2. AC Analysis for Gain and Bandwidth
ac dec 100 1k 100G
let vout_diff = v(LABEL_NET_0) - v(X)
let vin_diff = v(Y) - v(VIN)
let gain_mag = mag(vout_diff) / mag(vin_diff)
let gain_db = 20 * log10(gain_mag)

meas ac max_gain MAX gain_db
let gain_3db = max_gain - 3
meas ac bw_3db WHEN gain_db=gain_3db FALL=1

* 3. Transient Analysis for Signal Swing
tran 10p 5u
meas tran vout_p_max MAX v(LABEL_NET_0)
meas tran vout_p_min MIN v(LABEL_NET_0)
meas tran vout_n_max MAX v(X)
meas tran vout_n_min MIN v(X)

quit
.endc
.end
